name: Variable Interest
definition: Specifies the estimated interest rate and the parameters used for determining its value.

VariableRateChangeFrequency.name: Variable Rate Change Frequency
VariableRateChangeFrequency.definition: Specifies the frequency of change to the variable rate of an interest bearing instrument.

FixingDate.name: Fixing Date
FixingDate.definition: Date/time at which the rate determination is made, also called determination date, for instance the date the interest rate of a floating rate note will be/was calculated, according to the terms of the issue.

ReportingDate.name: Reporting Date
ReportingDate.definition: Last date the new interest rate must be reported to the market.

ResetDate.name: Reset Date
ResetDate.definition: Date/time at which the interest rate of an interest bearing instrument will be reset, according to the terms of the issue.

Arrears.name: Arrears
Arrears.definition: Indicates that the rate reset will occur at the end of the payment period (True case)

EstimatedInterestRate.name: Estimated Interest Rate
EstimatedInterestRate.definition: Estimated per annum ratio of interest paid to the principal amount of the financial instrument for a specific period of time.

VariableRateValueDate.name: Variable Rate Value Date
VariableRateValueDate.definition: Date/time as of which the variable rate is valid.

InterestCalculation.name: Interest Calculation
InterestCalculation.definition: Interest calculation for which a variable interest is used.

Index.name: Index
Index.definition: Identifies the index used for calculating the interest

YieldCalculation.name: Yield Calculation
YieldCalculation.definition: Yield calculation for which a variable interest is used.

BenchmarkReference.name: Benchmark Reference
BenchmarkReference.definition: Benchmark rate against which variable rate instruments are measured to determine the interest rate, for example, LIBOR.

LifeCalculation.name: Life Calculation
LifeCalculation.definition: Lfe calculation for which a variable interest is used.

DurationCalculation.name: Duration Calculation
DurationCalculation.definition: Duration calculation for which a variable interest is used.
